svg.title: H003 local nuclear separation repair and retained faint-neighbour merge
svg.desc: Matched original native DNA captures. C4 raw, first-complete combined and final combined show local separation; C2 final raw, ROI-only and combined retain a joined faint neighbour. Same-author development, not an accuracy estimate.
